# Core Summary
A cinematic 15-second sequence follows a traveler walking through a modern international airport terminal at night, utilizing a multi-shot structure (3 shots) to build narrative momentum. The clip opens with a low-angle tracking shot emphasizing polished floor reflections and the vast glass ceiling, transitions to a side-tracking view as the traveler passes a massive glowing flight information display, and concludes with a sharp close-up of a digital boarding pass held in hand against the blurred terminal lights.

# Scene
[shot1][00:00-00:06]
Modern international airport terminal interior at night. The floor is highly polished dark stone, reflecting overhead lights like a mirror. Above, a massive curved glass ceiling reveals the dark night sky mixed with interior structural beams. Lighting is cool and ambient with warm accents from distant shop fronts. Deep depth of field to capture both floor texture and ceiling architecture.
Audio: Low ambient hum of airport ventilation, distant rolling luggage wheels, soft echoing footsteps on stone.

[shot2][00:06-00:11]
Same terminal area, focusing on the wall of flight information. A massive, glowing digital flight information display system (FIDS) dominates the background, emitting bright white and blue light. Hanging from the ceiling are illuminated directional signs with icons and text. The environment feels busy but spacious.
Audio: Subtle electronic chime from the display screen, ambient crowd murmur fades slightly as focus shifts to the screen.

[shot3][00:11-00:15]
Extreme close-up perspective. The background is a soft bokeh of terminal lights (blue and orange orbs). The foreground is sharply focused on a smartphone screen. Lighting is primarily sourced from the phone screen itself, illuminating the hand holding it.
Audio: Sharp focus on the sound of a thumb tapping the screen, ambient noise dips to highlight the digital interface interaction.

# Subjects Description
<ID_A>
- Gender: Male.
- Race/Ethnicity: East Asian.
- Age: Young adult.
- Appearance features: Wearing a modern dark travel jacket, carrying a sleek carry-on bag in one hand (visible in wide shots), short neat black hair. Casual but stylish travel attire.
- Vocal Characteristics: N/A (No dialogue).

# Dynamic Narrative
[shot1][00:00-00:06]
Low-angle tracking shot moving forward smoothly just above the floor. <ID_A> walks away from the camera in the center frame, legs and shoes visible, stepping rhythmically on the polished stone. The floor reflects the overhead lights and <ID_A>'s silhouette clearly. The camera tilts up slightly to reveal the vast glass ceiling structure stretching into the distance. <ID_A> maintains a steady walking pace towards the terminal depth.

[shot2][00:06-00:11]
Medium-wide side tracking shot. Camera moves parallel to <ID_A> as he walks from left to right across the frame. <ID_A> passes directly in front of the massive glowing flight information display screen. The screen displays rows of flight numbers, destinations, and "On Time" status in green text. In the background above, illuminated signs show icons and text for "行李提取" (Baggage Claim), "地面交通" (Ground Transportation), and "贵宾休息室" (VIP Lounge). <ID_A> glances briefly at the screen while continuing to walk forward toward the gate direction.

[shot3][00:11-00:15]
Extreme close-up insert shot. <ID_A>'s hand holds a smartphone steady in the center of the frame. The screen displays a digital boarding pass with a clear QR code, "Gate C12", and "Seat 24A". The background is a creamy bokeh of the terminal's闪烁 (flickering) lights. <ID_A>'s thumb rests near the bottom edge of the phone. The camera pushes in slightly on the QR code to emphasize the readiness for boarding.

# Style, Color & Aesthetics
- **Visual Style:** High-end travel commercial aesthetic, sleek and modern.
- **Color Palette:** Cool teal and midnight blue tones for the terminal architecture, contrasted with warm amber and white lights from signage and screens.
- **Lighting:** High contrast with strong specular highlights on the polished floor. Volumetric lighting effects around the FIDS screen to show glow.
- **Texture:** Smooth glass, reflective stone, crisp digital screens.
- **Image Quality:** Cinematic sharpness, shallow depth of field in close-ups, anamorphic lens flares subtle in highlights.

# Atmosphere & Emotion
- **Atmosphere:** Anticipatory, sleek, slightly solitary but connected. The quiet hustle of late-night travel.
- **Emotion:** Focus and readiness. The feeling of being on the verge of a journey, calm amidst the large infrastructure.
